# Atlantic City Quests, New Locations, and Rewards

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Mar 26, 2024
- 7 min read

Updated: Jul 29, 2024

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_c8eeb787c5244a74a93507319cd3efce~mv2.png)

With thanks to SugarBombsRads and Coffee888.

****SUBJECT TO CHANGE PORTING TO LIVE SERVERS****

Out of respect for the Game Devs and their hard work in writing and creating the storyline, this guide will not go into detail on the questline, nor have many spoilers in it. It will cover a general walk-through, any tips or gear needed, as well as the quest rewards.

You will need:

- Lock Pick and Hacking perk cards or Master Infiltrator Legendary perk card.
- Food and Chem buffs for SPECIAL checks during conversations with NPCs.

Lists of buffs that boost each Special can be found __here__.

__Quests__

There are 3 stand-alone quests and one full-length quest coming with the Atlantic City Part 2 update in March 2024.

The easiest way to find the quest starters for these is to fast-travel to Whitesprings Refuge and head over to the room where Sophie and Jeremiah are based. The posters and notes to start the quests are on the walls and pillars.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_7ae8bc3fd43647f79a924dd18afab7f6~mv2.jpg)

**Stand-alone Quests**

- Regent of the Dead
- Custodial Compulsions
- Hells Eagles

**Full-length Quest (4 parts)**

- Opportunity Knocking
- All the World's a Stage
- Honor Bound
- Sins of the Father

The rewards checklist can be found __here__.

**Quest Name:**

Opportunity Knocking

Attend opening night at Appalachia's newest...nightlife destination?

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_f215c93709794762930cdc535c176189~mv2.gif)

**Quest Type:**

Part of the full questline.

**How to start the quest:**

Read the poster which can be found at all Train Stations.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_06979f671d264357a9532b1fa687b420~mv2.jpg)

OR

Enter The Rose Room (Formally known as Ingram Mansion)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_426c508de0b64d90bf1a9e59f2f67ff3~mv2.jpg)

**Notes and Tips for the Quest:**

Boost your Charisma before speaking to the Bartender for some extra caps.

**Rewards:**

Caps

XP

Stimpaks

RadAway

Grenades/Mines

Legendary Item - Murmrgh's Mystery Pick

**Plan: Civil Engineer Armour Helmet**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_86ea2e2d189b4678a9d8186b8668200b~mv2.jpg)

**Plan: Socialite Outfit**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_390d8f4aab3048e09ae280a86b84a50f~mv2.jpg)

**Quest Name:**

All the World's a Stage

Acquire a taste of Atlantic City's high life...and learn its consequences.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_b8e2bedec202433681ef6c91109f75d2~mv2.jpg)

**Quest Type:**

Part of the full questline.

**How to start the quest:**

Complete the previous quest Opportunity Knocks.

**Notes and Tips for the Quest:**

The key to the High Rollers Lounge can be found on the desk in the Security Office, in the Kitchen section.

Bring 5000 caps for a bribe or have completed at least one Tax Evasion Expo as Team Leader before starting this quest.

The best way to complete the pie task is to stand with your back to the table, facing the stage. Watch the map markers on your HUD and throw the pie when the map marker gets down to 3 feet.

Equip the perk card Fire in the Hole under Perception if you struggle with aiming.

**Rewards:**

Caps

XP

Stimpaks

RadAway

Grenades/Mines

Legendary Item - Murmrgh's Mystery Pick

**Plan: Civil Engineer Armour Left Arm**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_74646f34378d4f6796f6ee7ca041321a~mv2.jpg)

**Plan: Civil Engineer Armour Right Arm**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e2a10907aa104b82854b9a43474c337c~mv2.jpg)

**Plan: Spectacular Performer's Headwear**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_135d504459a04f1987f601b0bd134562~mv2.jpg)

**Plan: Spectacular Performer's Outfit**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e807e1907cc3412dae90cc2e67721f0f~mv2.jpg)

**Quest Name:**

Honor Bound

Find a cure for a deadly addiction.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_51c667acea584575b91613162cf326c3~mv2.jpg)

This is my favourite quest line. Very well written 10/10.

**Quest Type:**

Part of the full questline.

**How to start the quest:**

Complete the previous quest All the World's a Stage.

**Notes and Tips for the Quest:**

There is a Specials check that requires 12+ Luck to progress the quest so bring your buffs.

Read the note on the wall next to the back door to unlock it. The answer is 4.

The answer is "Spicy".

The valves are numbered and the code is 3, 2, 4,1.

There is a Specials check that requires 8+ Strength to progress the quest so bring your buffs.

**Rewards:**

Caps

XP

Stimpaks

RadAway

Grenades/Mines

Legendary Item - Murmrgh's Mystery Pick

**Plan: Civil Engineer Armour Left Leg**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e751d55ca50b4f20aebff349cc28b013~mv2.jpg)

**Plan: Civil Engineer Armour Right Leg**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_46cd4eba6d354f7895294bbdedab8c67~mv2.jpg)

**Quest Name:**

Sins of the Father

Attain the blood of the Jersey Devil in order to save Abbie Russo's life.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a8a405c73af7486590a68cbb98f4c0ec~mv2.gif)

**Quest Type:**

Part of the full questline.

**How to start the quest:**

Complete the previous quest Honor Bound.

**Notes and Tips for the Quest:**

Be prepared for a fight. The end boss is a bit tanky and hits hard.

Bring a bottle of Liquid Courage and pop it just before you take on the boss.

There are three different endings for this quest.

The endings affect the rewards you receive at the end.

- Good Ending Achieved

Convince Abbie to stay with her family and to get clean from her addiction.

- Neutral Ending Achieved

Convince Abbie to take the antidote but she intends on staying in Atlantic City.

- Evil Ending Achieved

Abbie runs off without taking the antidote, likely never to be seen again.

**Rewards:**

Caps

XP

Stimpaks

RadAway

Grenades/Mines

**Plan: Civil Engineer Armour Torso**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_4b0be4b38ad24de99df3aa30626ca105~mv2.jpg)

**Plan: Jersey Devil Plushie**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_69ea5ffb9d8f4bb5b6d91a06a17e234a~mv2.jpg)

PLUS one of the below plans, depending on what ending you pick.

**Plan: Civil Engineer Deep Pocketed Armour Limbs**

- The player saved Abbie and reunited the Russos (Good Ending).

**Plan: Civil Engineer Ultra-Light Build Armour Torso**

- The player saved Abbie but not the Russo family (Neutral Ending).

**Plan: Civil Engineer Sleek Armour Legs**

- The player did not save Abbie (Evil Ending).

**Quest Name:**

Regent of the Dead

Be the harbinger of the Lombardi Family's succession.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_ded623f363824aa5b618f88844286f32~mv2.gif)

**Quest Type:**

Stand alone.

**How to start the quest:**

To start the quest, fast-travel to the Whitesprings Refuge and head over to the desk where Jeremiah Hopkins is standing. Jeremiah can be found near Giuseppe's Curios.

Interact with the note on the pillar to the right of Jeremiah marked "Job Posting". This will add the quest to your pip-boy.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_bfd2f1571ab143848f889744d49af3be~mv2.jpg)

**Notes and Tips for the Quest:**

Unless it changes once being ported to the live servers, the code should be:

T - 6

P - 8

H - 4

D - 9

S - 2

*For people playing Fallout 76 in a language other than English, the hints, notes, and code do not piece together due to localization. You will need to temporarily switch to the English client during this part so you can complete the puzzle and the quest can continue.

**Rewards:**

Caps

Note "To the Arbiter"

Gold Watch

Pre-War Money

Silver Locket

Silver Watch

Additional plan from the __Mutated Party Pack__ 

**Plan: Civil Engineer Pneumatic Armour Torso**

PLUS one of the below plans, depending on what ending you pick.

**Plan: Civil Engineer Stabilized Armour Arms**

- The player chose to side with Concerta.

**Plan: Civil Engineer Lead Lined Armour Torso**

- The player chose to side with Concerta WITHOUT killing Fabio.

**Plan: Civil Engineer Custom Fitted Armour Legs**

- The player killed Concerta.

**Plan: Civil Engineer Cushioned Armour Legs**

- The player persuaded Concerta to step down peacefully.

**Plan: Civil Engineer Brawling Armour Arms**

- The player killed both Fabio and Concerta.

**Plan: Civil Engineer Lead Lined Armour Limbs**

- The player sided with Fabio and ratted Concerta out.

**Quest Name:**

Custodial Compulsions

It's just an ordinary clean-up job.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_c9de36d0627c4981a6de31cb1c7ac8c4~mv2.jpg)

**Quest Type:**

Stand alone.

**How to start the quest:**

Complete the Quest Opportunity Knocking, All the World's a Stage, and Honor Bound first. Once you have completed those quests, fast travel inside the Whitesprings Refuge and;

Read the flyer "Help Wanted"

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d558661abb5940aba80354a89e27afd4~mv2.jpg)

**Notes and Tips for the Quest:**

Grab the two boxes of Sugar Bombs with Rads that are on the shelf next to Sam.

Don't wait for Sam to enter the buildings. Just run ahead of him and load in.

Pick up trash piles

Wipe away blood on the stage

Pick up stage props

Optional Objectives (unlocks additional dialogue)

- Collected all notes and holotapes
- All cleaning objectives completed

There are plenty of map markers leading you to all the objectives. Just walk around the stage area and they will show on your HUD when you get close enough to them.

Two of the items can be a little tricky to find.

One is near the yellow cash register, in the shop on the North side of the building.

The second one is on the pew (bench), near the door, on the East side of the room.

Two Specials checks require 4+ Perception to progress the quest so bring your buffs.

**Notes to collect**

- Big, Dumb Nuisance
- Curtain Call
- Method Acting Mandate

**Holotapes to collect**

- A Special Surprise
- Stella Meets Stratton
- The Final Scene

**Props to collect**

- Prop Gun
- Feather Boa
- Strattons Briefcase

**Rewards:**

Caps

XP

Abraxo Cleaner Industrial Grade

Clean Broom

Mop

Additional plan from the __Mutated Party Pack__ 

**Plan: Saltwater Taffy Outfit**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_8d90ca5adc424a688e6deca186324928~mv2.jpg)

**Plan: Suspicious Trunk (Stash Box)**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_57ff3208c34a4b0f8177183136208bb5~mv2.jpg)

**Quest Name:**

Hells Eagles

Follow the trail of an eccentric journalist into the depths of depravity.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e8f19fee35c44790aeba8cfcd26ef02e~mv2.jpg)

**Quest Type:**

Stand alone.

**How to start the quest:**

Read the Flyer

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_8cc6f8d2556a48c6b92c0aa7f31e4b52~mv2.jpg)

OR

Speak to Oscar Gonzalez inside Crater Core.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_8db6044da6b642ebbd556f98871f938f~mv2.jpg)

**Notes and Tips for the Quest:**

At Surly's Shack, you have two options. You can read the note in the blue cooler by the door first, which will skip all dialogue and you can move into the next part of the quest, or you can speak to Surly first.

**Rewards:**

Caps

XP

Med-X

Psyco

Buffout

Additional plan from the __Mutated Party Pack__ 

**Plan: Civil Engineer Lighter Build Armour Limbs**

**Plan: Civil Engineer Asbstos Lined Armour Torso**

"Hells Eagles" Note

Rewarded if the player completed the interview with Little Rob peacefully.
